main.description: Self-signed P-256 ECDSA endpoint certificate for AT-SMS secure messaging. One record per device, keyed by the device fingerprint (SHA-256 of the raw uncompressed public-key point, lowercase hex) — structurally paired with at.atsms.prekey/<fingerprint>.

certificate.description: The X.509 certificate in PEM format (P-256 ECDSA, self-signed)

serialNumber.description: Certificate serial number (hexadecimal) — a field of the X.509 artifact (CMS IssuerAndSerialNumber); NOT the record key. The rkey is the device fingerprint.

validUntil.description: Expiration date of the certificate (ISO 8601 format)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this record was created (ISO 8601 format)
